for sheet in range((len(pages)+3)//4):
    group=pages[sheet*4:sheet*4+4]
    canvas=Image.new('RGB',(1672,2212),'#d0d0d0')
    draw=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    for j,path in enumerate(group):
        with Image.open(path) as im:
            tile=ImageOps.contain(im.convert('RGB'),(816,1056))
            x=10+(j%2)*836; y=34+(j//2)*1106
            canvas.paste(tile,(x,y))
            draw.text((x,y-27),f'Page {sheet*4+j+1}',font=font,fill='black')

import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
draft=Path('publications/drafts/bit-php-resolution-over-parities')
scratch=Path('research/tmp/whitepaper-135')
out=Path('research/results/bit_php_expanded_whitepaper_20260914_135')
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:stream.read(1048576),b''): h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()
assert len(list(scratch.glob('verified-*.png')))==19
unchanged=[]
for page in range(3,20):
    assert sha(scratch/f'page-{page:02}.png')==sha(scratch/f'verified-{page:02}.png'),page
    unchanged.append(page)
for page in (1,2):
    assert sha(scratch/f'final-front-{page:02}.png')==sha(scratch/f'verified-{page:02}.png'),page
log=(draft/'whitepaper.log').read_text()
assert not re.search(r'LaTeX Warning|Overfull|Underfull|undefined|Rerun to get',log)
info=subprocess.check_output(['pdfinfo',str(draft/'whitepaper.pdf')],text=True)
assert re.search(r'Pages:\s+19\b',info)
assert re.search(r'Author:\s+Kamil Braun',info)
texfiles=sorted(draft.rglob('*.tex'))
tex='\n'.join(p.read_text() for p in texfiles)
labels=re.findall(r'\\label\{([^}]+)\}',tex)
assert len(labels)==len(set(labels))
refs=re.findall(r'\\(?:ref|eqref)\{([^}]+)\}',tex)
assert all(r in labels for r in refs)
bibs=re.findall(r'\\bibitem(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\{([^}]+)\}',tex)
cites=[c for g in re.findall(r'\\cite(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\{([^}]+)\}',tex) for c in g.split(',')]
assert all(c in bibs for c in cites)
text=(scratch/'whitepaper-final.txt').read_text()
assert '??' not in text
for name in ('Kamil Braun','Claude Sonnet','Claude Opus','Claude Fable','GPT-6 Astra'):
    assert name in text,name
urls=subprocess.check_output(['pdfinfo','-f','1','-l','19','-url',str(draft/'whitepaper.pdf')],text=True)
for anchor in ('publication-Res-parity-bit-PHP-theorem','bit-PHP-publication-audit-verdict'):
    assert '#'+anchor in urls,anchor
for suffix in ('aux','log','out','toc'):
    assert subprocess.run(['git','check-ignore','-q',str(draft/('whitepaper.'+suffix))]).returncode==0
assert subprocess.run(['git','check-ignore','-q',str(draft/'whitepaper.pdf')]).returncode==1
assert (draft/'build.sh').stat().st_mode & 0o111
body=Path('notebook.html').read_text()
old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:notebook.html'],text=True)
record='<section id="research-record">'
marker='<!-- Append new dated mathematical entries here, preserving earlier entries. -->'
assert body.split(record,1)[1].startswith(old.split(record,1)[1].split(marker,1)[0].rstrip())
added='\n'.join(x[1:] for x in subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--unified=0','--','notebook.html'],text=True).splitlines() if x.startswith('+') and not x.startswith('+++'))
for anchor in set(re.findall('href="#([^"]+)"',added)): assert body.count('id="'+anchor+'"')==1
assert body.count('<!-- TIMING bit_php_expanded_whitepaper_20260914_135 -->')==1
for name in ('/tmp/math-commit135.txt','/tmp/math-commit-png-previews.txt'):
    assert max(map(len,Path(name).read_text().splitlines()))<=100
result={
 'status':'pass',
 'artifact':str(draft/'whitepaper.pdf'),
 'pages':19,
 'tex_files':[str(p) for p in texfiles],
 'labels':len(labels),'citations_resolved':sorted(set(cites)),
 'visual_review':{'pages_inspected':list(range(1,20)),
     'final_front_matter_inspected':[1,2],
     'final_body_pngs_identical_to_inspected_render':unchanged,
     'later_png_previews_kept_local_per_user_request':True},
 'final_latex_warnings':[],
 'failed_initial_builds':['Unbraced field subscript in span notation','Text URL placed in math mode'],
 'mathematical_review':'One focused expansion and composition review of the existing binary proof; no correction to the theorem identified. Homological background supplied inline.',
 'review_status':'Working draft for user review; no external or formal verification',
 'new_numerical_theorem_checks':False,
 'dependencies_installed':False,
 'source_notebook_checkpoint':'08dcee3',
 'latex_build':'build.sh --session TURN; three protected pdflatex passes with shell escape disabled',
 'bibliography_verification':{
    'BIKPRS_publisher':'https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF01294258',
    'EGI_publisher':'https://epubs.siam.org/doi/10.1137/24M1696640',
    'original_system_bibliography':'https://drops.dagstuhl.de/entities/document/10.4230/LIPIcs.CCC.2024.23'},
 'old_notebook_record_unchanged':True,

}
(out/'draft-review.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'pdf-links.txt').write_text(urls)
